composition_variation: Create an original anime depiction of adult Fubuki, with her recognizable dark emerald bob, vivid green eyes, and refined beautiful face. Dress her for summer in an opaque mint-green sleeveless sundress with a secure neckline and a softly structured above-knee skirt, paired with comfortable white sandals. She pauses mid-step in a bright courtyard, weight resting naturally on one leg, one hand brushing windblown hair beside her temple, and the other resting lightly on a nearby curved railing. Her expression is poised and subtly playful, and her elbows remain close enough for a narrow wallpaper crop. Use mint, deep forest green, white hydrangeas, and cool turquoise reflections. Nonsexual everyday scene, one character, no combat. Leave spacious pale atmosphere above; head near forty percent height, face and both hands entirely centered.
